notes.title: Game now Available
notes.content:
After a lot of work to get the game ready, I am pleased to present the game for early access players.

Latest Updates/Fixes:
[list]
    [*]New Resources: Water, Cake and Bread
    [*]Speed up town upgrade / repair by providing bread
    [*]New Resource production tiles: Well and Bakery (programmer art)
    [*]Update Town Moat destroyed artwork
[/list]

There is also development progress blog which can be found: 

http://slaythedragongamedevblog.blogspot.com/

I hope that you will all enjoy playing the game, leave any feedback or suggestions on the community.

notes.title: One week to go!!
notes.content:
With the upcoming release of Slay the Dragon into early access, and after a flurry of development, I can share some detail around what is being worked on and what I plan to work on next.

Latest changes:
[list]
    [*]New Non Combat Encounter: Discount Potion Warehouse
    [*]Updated Player Character
    [*]Animated villages, quest tiles and resource tiles
    [*]Added Mini Map
    [*]Added Temple Minigame
    [*]New Town Moat Artwork
    [*]Updated Store Page and Trailer to reflect new artlwork
[/list]

Upcoming changes:
[list]
    [*]New Combat Ability: Charm
    [*]Non Combat Encounter(s): Fetch and Delivery missions for the princess.
    [*]New Resources: Water, Cake and Bread
    [*]New Resource production tiles: Well and Bakery
[/list]

On a longer term note I'm planning to add the following features to the game:

[list]
    [*]Different ways to win the game
    [*]More encouters
    [*]Minigame improvements
    [*]More intelligent AI for the dice game opponents
    [*]Customizable map generation
[/list]

I'm really looking forward to getting the game out there, and getting feedback from the community to make the game better.
